def _model(app_name, model_name):
    if not app_name or not model_name:
        raise Http404("Referência de entidade inválida na página avançada.")
    model = apps.get_model(app_name, model_name)
    if model is None:
        raise Http404("Entidade da página avançada não encontrada.")
    return model


def _model_for(page):
    return _model(page.get("context_app_name"), page.get("context_model_name"))


def _rbac_for(app_name):
    if not app_name:
        return None
    try:
        return __import__(f"{app_name}.rbac", fromlist=["has_entity_action"])
    except Exception:
        return None


def _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, action):
    rbac = _rbac_for(app_name)
    if rbac is None:
        return False
    try:
        return bool(rbac.has_entity_action(request.user, entity_name, action))
    except Exception:
        return False


def _require_page_access(request, page):
    entity_name = page.get("context_entity")
    kind = page.get("context_kind")
    if kind == "none":
        return
    if kind not in {"collection", "record"} or not entity_name:
        raise PermissionDenied("Contexto da página avançada inválido.")
    action = "list" if kind == "collection" else "view"
    if not _has_entity_action(request, page.get("context_app_name"), entity_name, action):
        raise PermissionDenied(f"Acesso negado para {entity_name}:{action}.")


def _action_allowed(request, page, action):
    if not action or not action.get("url_name"):
        return False
    kind = action.get("kind")
    if kind == "navigate":
        target_kind = action.get("target_context_kind")
        target_entity = action.get("target_context_entity")
        if target_kind == "none":
            return True
        if target_kind not in {"collection", "record"} or not target_entity:
            return False
        target_action = "list" if target_kind == "collection" else "view"
        return _has_entity_action(request, action.get("target_context_app_name"), target_entity, target_action)
    entity = action.get("entity")
    app_name = action.get("app_name")
    if kind == "crud":
        return bool(entity and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity, action.get("operation")))
    rbac = _rbac_for(app_name)
    if rbac is None or not entity:
        return False
    try:
        if kind == "workflow":
            return bool(rbac.can_transition(request.user, entity, action.get("transition")))
        if kind == "report":
            return bool(rbac.can_report(request.user, entity, action.get("report")))
    except Exception:
        return False
    return False


def _action_url(page, action, *, advanced_record=None):
    if not action or not action.get("url_name"):
        return ""
    kwargs = {}
    if action.get("requires_pk"):
        if advanced_record is None:
            return ""
        kwargs["pk"] = advanced_record.pk
    if action.get("kind") == "workflow":
        kwargs["transition_id"] = action.get("transition")
    try:
        return reverse(action["url_name"], kwargs=kwargs or None)
    except NoReverseMatch:
        return ""


def _workflow_confirmation(action):
    if not action or action.get("kind") != "workflow":
        return False, ""
    app_name = action.get("app_name")
    model_name = action.get("model_name")
    transition_id = action.get("transition")
    if not app_name or not model_name or not transition_id:
        return False, ""
    try:
        workflow = __import__(f"{app_name}.workflow", fromlist=["WORKFLOWS"])
        config = (getattr(workflow, "WORKFLOWS", {}) or {}).get(model_name) or {}
        transition = next((item for item in config.get("transitions", []) if item.get("id") == transition_id), None)
        if not transition:
            return False, ""
        confirm = bool(transition.get("confirm"))
        message = str(transition.get("confirm_message") or "Confirme para continuar.") if confirm else ""
        return confirm, message
    except Exception:
        return False, ""


def _component_native_url(component, *, advanced_record=None):
    name = component.get("native_url_name")
    if not name:
        return ""
    kwargs = {}
    if component.get("native_requires_pk"):
        if advanced_record is None:
            return ""
        kwargs["pk"] = advanced_record.pk
    try:
        return reverse(name, kwargs=kwargs or None)
    except NoReverseMatch:
        return ""


def _component_allowed(request, page, component):
    action_id = component.get("action_id")
    if action_id:
        return _action_allowed(request, page, page.get("actions", {}).get(action_id))
    kind = component.get("binding_kind")
    component_type = component.get("type")
    entity_name = component.get("binding_entity")
    app_name = component.get("binding_app_name")
    if component_type == "form":
        operation = component.get("native_operation")
        return bool(entity_name and operation in {"create", "update"} and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, operation))
    if component_type == "report":
        rbac = _rbac_for(app_name)
        if rbac is None or not entity_name or not component.get("report_id"):
            return False
        try:
            return bool(rbac.can_report(request.user, entity_name, component.get("report_id")))
        except Exception:
            return False
    if component_type == "dashboard":
        return True
    if kind in {"none", "page_context"}:
        return True
    if kind in {"entity", "crud"}:
        action = "list" if component_type == "table" else "view"
        return bool(entity_name and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, action))
    if kind in {"field", "workflow"}:
        return bool(entity_name and _has_entity_action(request, app_name, entity_name, "view"))
    return False


def _load_component_data(page, component, *, advanced_record=None, advanced_collection=None):
    kind = component.get("binding_kind")
    if kind == "page_context":
        return advanced_record if page.get("context_kind") == "record" else advanced_collection
    if kind in {"entity", "crud"}:
        return _model(component.get("binding_app_name"), component.get("binding_model_name"))._default_manager.all()
    if kind == "field":
        if advanced_record is None or component.get("binding_entity") != page.get("context_entity"):
            return None
        field_name = component.get("binding_field")
        return getattr(advanced_record, field_name, None) if field_name else None
    return None


def _form_class(component):
    app_name = component.get("binding_app_name")
    class_name = component.get("form_class_name")
    if not app_name or not class_name:
        return None
    try:
        module = __import__(f"{app_name}.forms", fromlist=[class_name])
        return getattr(module, class_name, None)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _apply_form_contracts(component, form):
    app_name = component.get("binding_app_name")
    operation = component.get("native_operation")
    if operation == "create":
        try:
            workflow = __import__(f"{app_name}.workflow", fromlist=["apply_initial_state"])
            workflow.apply_initial_state(form.instance)
        except Exception as exc:
            form.add_error(None, str(exc))
            return False
    try:
        rules = __import__(f"{app_name}.business_rules", fromlist=["run_business_rules"])
        rules.run_business_rules(form.instance, "before_create" if operation == "create" else "before_update")
    except Exception as exc:
        form.add_error(None, str(exc))
        return False
    return True


def _build_form_component(request, page, component, *, advanced_record=None):
    form_class = _form_class(component)
    if form_class is None:
        return None, False
    operation = component.get("native_operation")
    instance = None
    if operation == "update":
        if advanced_record is None or component.get("binding_entity") != page.get("context_entity"):
            return None, False
        instance = advanced_record
    active = request.method == "POST" and request.POST.get("_advanced_form_component") == component.get("id")
    form = form_class(request.POST if active else None, instance=instance)
    if active and form.is_valid() and _apply_form_contracts(component, form):
        if operation == "create" and hasattr(form.instance, "criado_por_id") and not getattr(form.instance, "criado_por_id", None):
            form.instance.criado_por = request.user
        form.save()
        messages.success(request, "Dados salvos com sucesso.")
        return form, True
    return form, False


@login_required
def advanced_page_view(request, page_id, pk=None):
    page = ADVANCED_PAGES.get(page_id)
    if page is None:
        raise Http404("Página avançada não encontrada.")
    _require_page_access(request, page)
    kind = page["context_kind"]
    context = {"advanced_page": page, "advanced_record": None, "advanced_collection": None}
    if kind == "record":
        if pk is None:
            raise Http404("Registro da página avançada não informado.")
        context["advanced_record"] = get_object_or_404(_model_for(page), pk=pk)
    elif kind == "collection":
        context["advanced_collection"] = _model_for(page)._default_manager.all()
    elif kind != "none":
        raise Http404("Contexto da página avançada inválido.")

    for component in page.get("components", []):
        key = component["runtime_key"]
        visible = _component_allowed(request, page, component)
        action = page.get("actions", {}).get(component.get("action_id")) if component.get("action_id") else None
        action_url = _action_url(page, action, advanced_record=context["advanced_record"]) if visible and action else ""
        native_url = _component_native_url(component, advanced_record=context["advanced_record"]) if visible else ""
        confirm, confirm_message = _workflow_confirmation(action) if visible else (False, "")
        if action and not action_url:
            visible = False
            confirm, confirm_message = False, ""
        if component.get("type") in {"report", "dashboard"} and not native_url:
            visible = False
        context[f"{key}_visible"] = visible
        context[f"{key}_action_url"] = action_url
        context[f"{key}_native_url"] = native_url
        context[f"{key}_confirm"] = confirm
        context[f"{key}_confirm_message"] = confirm_message
        if visible and component.get("type") == "form":
            form, saved = _build_form_component(request, page, component, advanced_record=context["advanced_record"])
            if form is None:
                context[f"{key}_visible"] = False
                context[key] = None
            else:
                context[key] = form
                if saved:
                    return redirect(request.path)
        else:
            context[key] = _load_component_data(page, component, advanced_record=context["advanced_record"], advanced_collection=context["advanced_collection"]) if visible else None
    return render(request, page["template"], context)
